title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.40482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call

translated_title: FIRME：面向演化的异构投资者知识的注册表锚定记忆图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.40482v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：复用投资者知识的金融AI工作流需要持久化记忆，以便在不丢失身份或来源信息的前提下整合跨来源、跨时期的观测。在知识图谱中，重复出现的观测可能采用不同的表面形式，导致关系历史碎片化，阻碍证据的累积。我们提出了面向记忆演化的融合与身份注册表（FIRME），这是一种注册表锚定的记忆图，能够将新输入的观测调和归并到持久的规范化关系中，同时保留其来源、时间和上下文。在单个时期内，基于规则的融合将投资者电话会议讨论与投资组合现金流信号直接关联，或通过固定的产品-主题本体进行关联。跨时期来看，规范化身份和持久别名将重复出现的观测引导至相同的关系历史；确定性的更新机制总结强化、失活和再激活等状态。我们在专有的投资者电话会议数据上对FIRME进行了评估……
tldr: FIRME提出了一种注册表锚定的记忆图方法，通过身份注册与基于规则的融合，将跨来源、跨时期的异构投资者知识归并到持久的规范化关系中，同时保留来源与上下文信息，实现证据在时间中的持续累积与演化。
en_tdlr: FIRME introduces a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles heterogeneous, recurring investor observations into persistent canonical relationships—retaining source, time, and context—thereby enabling evidence accumulation and evolution across sources and periods in financial AI workflows.
